title: [SEC2] Full chat re-fetch on every incoming message
description: In handleStateEvent() lines ~570,574,580: every incoming message triggers refreshChatList() which calls fetchChats() (Chat/query + Chat/get — two JMAP requests). For an active tailnet this fires constantly. Fix: track unreadCount locally in the chats Map and call refreshChatList only when Chat/changes.created has new chats, not on every Message/changes.
